review:
Big Bass Blast adds an electric twist to the Big Bass formula. Fisherman wilds can appear on reels one and five with a random multiplier of up to 10x in the base game, and throughout the game wilds collect fish money symbols worth up to 500x.

Three or more scatters trigger up to nine free spins, and when only two land on the electrified grid, a hook feature can reel in a third. In the bonus every seventh wild adds five spins and raises the multiplier to 2x, then 3x, then 10x. Pragmatic lists a 96.50% RTP. It suits series fans who want base-game multipliers.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
